# fabric_slice (Data Source)

Look up a FABRIC slice by `slice_id`, `id`, or `name` using the FABRIC orchestrator. When multiple arguments are set, `slice_id` takes precedence over `id`, and `id` takes precedence over `name`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look up a provisioned FABRIC slice by its UUID from the FABRIC portal or
# orchestrator slice list.
data "fabric_slice" "science_gateway" {
  slice_id = "3f1b62c1-7a5e-4f46-b4ea-58d8df8c0d70"
}

output "science_gateway_state" {
  value = data.fabric_slice.science_gateway.state
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `id` (String) FABRIC slice identifier used for lookup or assigned by the orchestrator after lookup.
- `name` (String) Slice name used for lookup or returned by the orchestrator after lookup.
- `slice_id` (String) FABRIC slice identifier used for lookup or assigned by the orchestrator after lookup.

### Read-Only

- `graph_id` (String) Topology graph identifier assigned by FABRIC.
- `lease_end_time` (String) Lease end time assigned by FABRIC and normalized by the provider.
- `lease_start_time` (String) Lease start time assigned by FABRIC and normalized by the provider.
- `state` (String) Current slice state assigned by the orchestrator.
